definitions.explanation: Each and every month; monthly. Used to express something that happens on a monthly basis. Functions as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{本|ほん}を{読|よ}みます。
{毎月|まいつき}{一|いち}{回|かい}{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ます。
examples.english: I watch a movie once a month.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{一|いち}{回|かい}{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the hospital once a month.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{友達|ともだち}に{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}きます。{今月|こんげつ}も{書|か}きました。
examples.english: I write letters to my friend every month. I wrote one this month too.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{電話|でんわ}で{母|はは}と{話|はな}します。{今月|こんげつ}も{電話|でんわ}しました。
examples.english: I talk with my mother on the phone every month. I called her this month too.

notes: Can also be read as まいげつ, though まいつき is more common in speech. Related time expressions: {先月|せんげつ} (last month), {今月|こんげつ} (this month), {来月|らいげつ} (next month).
